answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared harbor registry before it can trade. New identities start in a glacier lane: low rate limits and no access to high-value work until they accumulate verified history. A violet trust badge, earned only through completed jobs and peer attestations, unlocks higher limits. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate stake and slowly build history for each fake identity, so creating thousands of sock puppets costs real capital and time while honest agents pay nothing beyond one deposit.
